title: Deliver configured zero-result native binding and owned monotonic waits to dev
body:
The native appliance's monotonic-wait owner is held on work/environment-construction but absent from dev. A fresh dev delivery probe at 5b7e5675c fails because selected operation binding lacks both configured entry points: bind_selected_configured_operation and bind_selected_assigned_configured_operation. Dev also assumes one result port; time/tick waits produce no result. Do not weaken configuration checks or introduce a compatibility timer loop.

Deliver the smallest generic selected-operation prerequisites first, with independently retained expected Source configuration for ordinary and assigned binding, exact zero-result shapes, and positive/negative configuration and shape proofs. Preserve existing unconfigured callers, opaque locally issued authority, exact Host/Boot/Plan/Play/resource identity and allocation-free invocation. Then deliver the owned monotonic-wait crate, readiness/assigned transfer and revoked idle retirement with a supported cargo xtask entrance. Keep implementation files bounded and separate generic binding proof from physical device claims.

Held provenance: 0422993e1 (ordinary configured binding), 430f21596 (assigned configuration), b8c4836bb (exact port shapes), 6226cdfe6 through 8d74e6bd9 (owned wait and transfer), 5b0f66a0b (retirement). Adapt their smallest semantic delta to current dev rather than wholesale stale file replacement. Refs #6334, #6328 and #6345. This is prerequisite delivery, not acceptance of rearming, a resident recorder, network join success or the Pi client.


## Current omnibus admission (2026-10-24 UTC)

The exact timer headcc527, generic configured/port-shape regressions and Exhausted-state controls are now retained in the omnibus. Supported timer checks passed12 tests and strict all-target lint at combinedsource5ace. The actual older products failure is corrected by registering the standalone timer manifest/lock; the existing named coverage test executes1/pass and its --locked check leaves the lock unchanged. Native/physical timer installation is not claimed.

Current delivery source is `d677b25383b22ca2911f1ec49936ca7b4a3c86ee` in existing PR #6339, with fresh [Candidate40054154999](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40054154999). No additional PR was opened. [Current registry repair, exact positive test and preflight proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/d43f2818a0143dcdb81ee319ee11c975a578f5cc/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-lock-registry-20261024/d677b2538); [source-qualified production/Face proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/dc6cdb60a0214d50c05b3396b0f862c02e0354d7/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-final-20261024/eacbd8350). Full exact-head Candidate, actual dev delivery, applicable Integration and final scoped audits remain required; no issue closure from these local checks.
